text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer! Thanks for all your hard 
work today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, want some gum? Bubble gum, that 
is.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'll share my source of energy with you. A 
tired look doesn't suit your face.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So, let's have a contest to see who can 
blow the bigger bubble. Hehe, I'll teach 
you the trick if you want!
